label: Aristotelian modality at every world strengthens P1-prime
note: Same frame, power primitive PowerFor and world; the weak version is the strong one at the world w and the single proposition that every concretum contingent at w is absent. The strong version adds grounding at every other world and for every other proposition. Strictness: on the controls' three-world frame P1-prime holds non-vacuously (the joint absence is possible at a and fails at a) and the universal fails for the proposition that z obtains, which no being at a has a power for. Registered so that the several single-proposition grounding premises of the Pruss routes show their common principle; the routes keep the weak version. No certified difference (strength_comparison) is registered: the natural delta (grounding at every other world-proposition pair) is the universal with one instance removed, which needs a case split on equality of propositions and adds nothing a reviewer cannot read off the definitions.
